axes.concept: A hinged access pass laid on a decoration assembly stage: balloon rig, tear seam and registration corners come from Pictures’ physical world.
axes.layout: A centred 950px two-leaf access pass; 1120px ruled roster stage; grouped permission bench. At 767px the pass folds into one column and account rows become stacked records.
axes.navigation: Persistent bottom tool dock for Accounts, Roles and My account; a separate named account menu. Full text and icons remain visible, with native preview and language selectors.
axes.typography: System sans at 32/28px with tight title tracking, 26/18px light-weight physical-stage statement, 14/15px working copy and 12px monospace location and pass metadata.
axes.density: Generous 40px form padding and 32px sheet padding; 20px phone inner padding; ruled rows with 22px vertical space. A compact fixed dock keeps the working stage broad.
axes.components: Real Base UI/shadcn Button, Input, DropdownMenu, Dialog and destructive AlertDialog; Animate UI Checkbox; Skeleton. Custom pass, balloon rig, roster and permission grouping recompose those installed controls.
axes.colour: Pictures project tokens: light #faf9fc/#ffffff/#1c1425 with #6d3fe0; dark #0b0c10/#16181f/#f4f5f7 with #9479ff. Neutral surfaces; mauve on primary actions and balloons; green/red only convey status. Contrast-adjusted control edges and muted dark text are explicit proposals.
axes.motion: Spatial unfolding: perspective-hinged pass, three staggered balloon settles (780/920/1060ms), roster lateral settling and a Motion spring on the stage. Profile-aware 520/340/200ms surfaces, 200/140/90ms repeated controls. Reduced motion and ?still=1 remove travel and preserve every control.
